statement: Actual Pontryagin pairing and fixed-star relative data on every physical-vertical-edge selected-cusp source-loop shear fan.

own_values.k: 6*A_n, with A_n the actual integer Jin index

scope_limit: No integer lift of A_n is selected from its residue. The statement retains the actual source/scalar/caps and the physical-vertical-edge shear fans; it does not by itself assign a nonvertical fan value.
